scope.label: Closed Ethereum V2/V3 pilot, including factory vaults and funded retired V2 allocators, $10k cutoff
scope.definition: Non-self holder share-conversion value minus attributed internal share positions. Exact direct ownership; canonical metrics budgets and caps allocate routed positions once at the snapshot. Not a complete holder census or immediately withdrawable liquidity.
excludedFromScope: Hidden and sub-cutoff roots; retired V3 roots
scope.dependencies: Observed queue strategies are included for routing even when not selected roots

cutoffUnknownCandidates.name: Balancer Boosted Aave USD Pool yVault

limitations: Ownership discovery covers observed queues/direct holders, not all historical allocations, adapters or cross-chain routes
Internal ownership is relative to selected pilot roots, not all Yearn contracts
Routed attribution uses recorded-debt caps; residual unreported strategy-owned appreciation is not proof of external wallet ownership
Base asset prices are frozen historical quotes; selected share-token underlying is repriced through the child conversion
No future reports, deposits, withdrawals, losses, configuration changes or new accrual beyond scheduled unlocking are assumed

projection.validUntilMeaning: End of this historical pilot projection, not an assertion the snapshot remains live
projection.interpolation: linear between supplied timestamps; stop at validUntilTimestamp and request a refreshed snapshot

engine.use: Snapshot ownership budgets for routed positions; exact balances for direct internal holdings; no repeated future-dollar deductions
